data.title: Suspicious "Land Registry Entry" Invoice from Grundstücksregister Online Service GmbH
data.summary: Grundstücksregister Online Service GmbH, a private company, sent an invoice-style letter asking Johanna Beispielacker to pay €498.00 by 1 December 2026 for a two-year "entry" of her property Ackerstraße 26 in its own private register. The letter itself admits this is only an offer (Angebot) and has no connection to the official land register (Grundbuch).
data.explanation: This looks like a well-known scam pattern: a private company sends a document styled as an official invoice for a "land registry entry", but the small print says it is only an offer, and that a contract only arises if you pay. The entry has no connection to the real, official Grundbuch and brings no legal benefit. You do not need to pay this. If in doubt, do not transfer the €498.00, do not reply, and consider reporting it to consumer protection (Verbraucherzentrale) or the police (Anzeige wegen Betrugsversuch). Keep the letter as evidence but treat any payment demand as optional, not a real obligation.

key_facts.quote: Dieses Schreiben ist ein Angebot. Mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an; ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande.

items.title: Pay the disputed €498.00 'registration fee' (optional, likely a scam)
items.action: Do not pay unless you deliberately want this private, non-official listing; if in doubt, ignore the demand or report it as a suspected scam.
items.consequence: No legal land-registry effect occurs if you don't pay, since the letter is only an offer and no contract exists without payment.

warnings: This document mimics an official land-registry (Grundbuch) notice but is only a private company's offer for an unofficial listing, a known scam pattern targeting property owners.
The small print states a binding contract only arises upon payment, meaning there is no existing obligation to pay despite the invoice-style layout.
The requested payment is due in only about 7 days, a pressure tactic typical of such schemes; verify independently before transferring any money.
